english.title: Fail to comply with requirements of enforcement authority acting under Articles 25, 26, or 27 Cosmetics Regulation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with any requirement(s), **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF REQUIREMENT(S)..), made by the enforcement authority acting under article

(A)_[25 (non compliance by the responsible person)]_
(B)_[26 (non-compliance by distributors)]_
(C)_[27 (safeguard clause)]_

of the Cosmetics Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(3) and 13(4) of the Cosmetic Products Enforcement Regulations 2013.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 24 of the Cosmetic Products Enforcement Regulations 2013 for liability of other persons.
(ii) See regulation 23 for the defence of due diligence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,0000.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex, see regulation 22.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
